# Configure network egress `NEG`

[As built](../README.md) › Configure network egress

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Lets a user check, start and test the sealed network's internet access, backed by the egress proxy that validates DNS and TCP connections and the sealed-network management in export:ensure_proxy.
